persistence.graphRule: Authored model data is in GraphDocument and can be exported or explicitly saved before Host Apply, including representable invalid state. Snapshot save ACK confirms that content only. No Host owner or successful-publication prerequisite.

validationSemantics.strategy: Pinned per-NodeType stateReferences collect/remap plus typed resource closure; sameGraph+load reuse vs crossGraph clone, atomic importNode/connectEndpoints with requireValid, no generic string replacement.

persistence.graphRule: Authored model data is in GraphDocument and can be exported or explicitly saved before Host Apply, including representable invalid state. Snapshot save ACK confirms that content only. No Host owner or successful-publication prerequisite.
persistence.uiRule: Selection/navigation and field drafts are runtime view state. Declared layout/preferences/private Panel viewState use their own storage contracts; no duplicate Graph values. Legacy field retention belongs to the leaf behavior oracle.
persistence.runtimeRule: Live values/native resources follow Target lifetime. Tokens/leases/mirrors/History jobs are not GraphDocument. Host-stored document is a delivered snapshot; explicit reload/import is required to replace application state.

undoRedo.rule: Graph-owned changes use atomic Operation/shared History; context/view-only state uses its own lifetime. Copy只寫剪貼包，不改圖也不入Undo；成功Paste/Group/Localize/Independent由所在編輯操作形成history；失敗回復。Personal export不屬此能力且不入圖Undo。

undoRedo.rule: Graph-owned changes use atomic Operation/shared History; context/view-only state uses its own lifetime. Generation, validation and delivery never become Graph undo entries.

static-web.path: Browser bootstrap -> same Graph/NodeType/Generator contracts; optional host service must be explicitly paired.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.

static-web.path: Browser bootstrap -> same Graph/NodeType/Generator contracts; optional host service must be explicitly paired.

static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.

node-hosted.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

persistence.graphRule: Authored model data is in GraphDocument and can be exported or explicitly saved before Host Apply, including representable invalid state. Snapshot save ACK confirms that content only. No Host owner or successful-publication prerequisite.

undoRedo.rule: Graph-owned changes use atomic Operation/shared History; context/view-only state uses its own lifetime. Generation, validation and delivery never become Graph undo entries.

static-web.path: Browser bootstrap -> same Graph/NodeType/Generator contracts; optional host service must be explicitly paired.
static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

persistence.graphRule: Authored model data is in GraphDocument and can be exported or explicitly saved before Host Apply, including representable invalid state. Snapshot save ACK confirms that content only. No Host owner or successful-publication prerequisite.
persistence.uiRule: Selection/navigation and field drafts are runtime view state. Declared layout/preferences/private Panel viewState use their own storage contracts; no duplicate Graph values. Legacy field retention belongs to the leaf behavior oracle.

undoRedo.rule: Graph-owned changes use atomic Operation/shared History; context/view-only state uses its own lifetime. Generation, validation and delivery never become Graph undo entries.

static-web.path: Browser bootstrap -> same Graph/NodeType/Generator contracts; optional host service must be explicitly paired.
static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

persistence.graphRule: Authored model data is in GraphDocument and can be exported or explicitly saved before Host Apply, including representable invalid state. Snapshot save ACK confirms that content only. No Host owner or successful-publication prerequisite.
persistence.uiRule: Selection/navigation and field drafts are runtime view state. Declared layout/preferences/private Panel viewState use their own storage contracts; no duplicate Graph values. Legacy field retention belongs to the leaf behavior oracle.
persistence.runtimeRule: Live values/native resources follow Target lifetime. Tokens/leases/mirrors/History jobs are not GraphDocument. Host-stored document is a delivered snapshot; explicit reload/import is required to replace application state.

undoRedo.rule: Graph-owned changes use atomic Operation/shared History; context/view-only state uses its own lifetime. Generation, validation and delivery never become Graph undo entries.

static-web.path: Browser bootstrap -> same Graph/NodeType/Generator contracts; optional host service must be explicitly paired.
static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

stateOwnership.scope: Only the state domains used by this leaf are involved; accountable owner is not an aggregate owner.

persistence.graphRule: Authored model data is in GraphDocument and can be exported or explicitly saved before Host Apply, including representable invalid state. Snapshot save ACK confirms that content only. No Host owner or successful-publication prerequisite.
persistence.uiRule: Selection/navigation and field drafts are runtime view state. Declared layout/preferences/private Panel viewState use their own storage contracts; no duplicate Graph values. Legacy field retention belongs to the leaf behavior oracle.
persistence.runtimeRule: Live values/native resources follow Target lifetime. Tokens/leases/mirrors/History jobs are not GraphDocument. Host-stored document is a delivered snapshot; explicit reload/import is required to replace application state.

undoRedo.rule: Graph-owned changes use atomic Operation/shared History; context/view-only state uses its own lifetime. Generation, validation and delivery never become Graph undo entries.

static-web.path: Browser bootstrap -> same Graph/NodeType/Generator contracts; optional host service must be explicitly paired.
static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

undoRedo.rule: Graph-owned changes use atomic Operation/shared History; context/view-only state uses its own lifetime. Generation, validation and delivery never become Graph undo entries.

stateOwnership.runtime: Target provider owns actual values/native resources; Binding owns session intent, receipts and disposable mirrors. Observations do not mutate Graph.
stateOwnership.scope: Only the state domains used by this leaf are involved; accountable owner is not an aggregate owner.

persistence.graphRule: Authored model data is in GraphDocument and can be exported or explicitly saved before Host Apply, including representable invalid state. Snapshot save ACK confirms that content only. No Host owner or successful-publication prerequisite.
persistence.uiRule: Selection/navigation and field drafts are runtime view state. Declared layout/preferences/private Panel viewState use their own storage contracts; no duplicate Graph values. Legacy field retention belongs to the leaf behavior oracle.
persistence.runtimeRule: Live values/native resources follow Target lifetime. Tokens/leases/mirrors/History jobs are not GraphDocument. Host-stored document is a delivered snapshot; explicit reload/import is required to replace application state.

undoRedo.rule: Graph-owned changes use atomic Operation/shared History; context/view-only state uses its own lifetime. Generation, validation and delivery never become Graph undo entries.

electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.

static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

static-web.path: Browser bootstrap -> same Graph/NodeType/Generator contracts; optional host service must be explicitly paired.
static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

persistence.graphRule: Authored model data is in GraphDocument and can be exported or explicitly saved before Host Apply, including representable invalid state. Snapshot save ACK confirms that content only. No Host owner or successful-publication prerequisite.

persistence.runtimeRule: Live values/native resources follow Target lifetime. Tokens/leases/mirrors/History jobs are not GraphDocument. Host-stored document is a delivered snapshot; explicit reload/import is required to replace application state.

undoRedo.rule: Graph-owned changes use atomic Operation/shared History; context/view-only state uses its own lifetime. Generation, validation and delivery never become Graph undo entries.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.

static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification. Texture dimensionality, format, stage and binding limits are requested from shader-backend/texture-bindings. Default WebGL2 profile rejects 1D/Buffer and unresolved opaque array policies. Node/Electron packaging does not remove GLSL/backend limits; an actual supporting target provider is required.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: Browser or Node application -> same core -> configured service provider; server location is not user or host location.
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification. Texture dimensionality, format, stage and binding limits are requested from shader-backend/texture-bindings. Default WebGL2 profile rejects 1D/Buffer and unresolved opaque array policies. Node/Electron packaging does not remove GLSL/backend limits; an actual supporting target provider is required.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: Renderer -> same application core -> narrow injected bridge/provider; no Node/Electron import inside core.
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Pure/core model and bounded WebGL probes are not native TD/GPU or packaged runtime certification. Texture dimensionality, format, stage and binding limits are requested from shader-backend/texture-bindings. Default WebGL2 profile rejects 1D/Buffer and unresolved opaque array policies. Node/Electron packaging does not remove GLSL/backend limits; an actual supporting target provider is required.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: same portable application/model path
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Node service does not substitute for actual browser InputSurface, nor prove host support.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: same portable application/model path
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Bootstrap/IPC providers only; do not import Electron into application core.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

transformationChain.authority: Compiled responsibility boundaries from AC-002/02/03/05/06; source wording is retained separately in sourceSummary.

static-web.path: same portable application/model path
static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Browser permissions/storage/device/platform constraints remain explicit; no filesystem or host loopback assumed.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: same portable application/model path
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Node service does not substitute for actual browser InputSurface, nor prove host support.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: same portable application/model path
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Bootstrap/IPC providers only; do not import Electron into application core.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

remainingProductWork: Exact leaf input/DOM/render/provider behavior is not claimed; shared boundary mechanism is exercised.

transformationChain.authority: Compiled responsibility boundaries from AC-002/02/03/05/06; source wording is retained separately in sourceSummary.

static-web.path: same portable application/model path
static-web.bootstrapBoundary: Downloaded browser code has browser-granted capabilities only; static hosting supplies no native service. Host identity must be explicitly bound.
static-web.limitations: Browser permissions/storage/device/platform constraints remain explicit; no filesystem or host loopback assumed.
static-web.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

node-hosted.path: same portable application/model path
node-hosted.bootstrapBoundary: Service is located wherever Node runs; server-local files/windows are not client-local files/windows. Provider scope is explicit.
node-hosted.limitations: Node service does not substitute for actual browser InputSurface, nor prove host support.
node-hosted.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

electron.path: same portable application/model path
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Bootstrap/IPC providers only; do not import Electron into application core.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

sourceQualification.claim: Rendering, search ranking, CSS and keyboard dispatch remain product work; no authority to mutate model directly.
sourceQualification.proofBoundary: Listed cases validate the named architecture mechanism and its bounded compositions. They do not execute every original behavior contract or every catalog mode.
remainingProductWork: PQ01–03 qualify replaceable projection, preferences storage boundary and guarded actions; exact locale strings/ranking/CSS/product event binding remains product implementation work.

entries.failureSemantics: 條件不成立時忽略操作；不建立模型變更。

persistence.graphRule: Authored model data is in GraphDocument and can be exported or explicitly saved before Host Apply, including representable invalid state. Snapshot save ACK confirms that content only. No Host owner or successful-publication prerequisite.

undoRedo.rule: Graph-owned changes use atomic Operation/shared History; context/view-only state uses its own lifetime. 不建立圖的 Undo/Redo 步驟。

electron.path: same portable application/model path
electron.bootstrapBoundary: Only the privileged bridge adapter gains desktop capabilities. Renderer/application contracts remain the same; packaging alone does not create a TD connection.
electron.limitations: Bootstrap/IPC providers only; do not import Electron into application core.
electron.unavailableBehavior: Keep document/model available; unsupported backend/provider returns a typed unavailable/error result. Never silently connect another target.

Alpha Map 取紅色通道而非 A；全白中性圖讓 mapped 值等於 Uniform，平坦法線 (0.5,0.5,1) 不改基礎法線。
PBR 的 RGB 只預乘材質 alphaMapped／alpha，不另乘 point.a；point.a 只進最終 Alpha。Phong 則在全部光照／Emission 結果後乘材質 Alpha 與 point.rgb。

persistence.graphRule: 僅持有 Graph 文件、來源宣告及預設、模組／資源引用；宿主實際值和控制租約不得回填。
persistence.runtimeRule: identity incarnation、leases、pending requests、mirrors、preview gestures/holds 以 session 為生命期；不得保存後復活舊 authority。
persistence.durabilityEvidence: 原型僅記憶體；尚未執行持久 provider、崩潰恢復、冷啟動驗證。
persistence.targetStorageRule: 宿主持有 controls/pages/source binding 的定義与穩定 identity；NativeDefinitions 是觀察／計畫模型，commit 成功才認列定義更新。NativeDefinitionHistory receipt session-bound；保存資料不能復活舊 authority 或 callback。

transformationChain.legacyBehavior: 未遷移的expose宣告由public_uniforms產生控制；矩陣每column是rows數值的Float group，colorsequence是RGBA，boolscalar Toggle，其餘按族Int/Float。重Apply復用Par物件並更新default/label。
transformationChain.legacyAssumption: TDnativePar的外部references依賴對象identity，矩陣native資料另用matrixbinding
transformationChain.preservedIntent: 已有公開控制與外部引用持續有效，同時可正確顯示矩陣與取消公開的狀態。
